messages.subject: install.package("rJava") fails
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
I am currently trying to run rJava with rho, but the installation fails with the following error below. Does anybody know the reason or can give some hint on how to get it running?

I compiled rho with --enable-provenance-tracking. To see if it makes a difference, I tried to compile with 'configure --enable-llvm-jit --enable-maintainer-mode', but in this case, rho fails during 'make' step, although the configuration runs without problems.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
config.status: creating R/zzz.R
config.status: creating src/config.h
** libs
gcc -std=gnu99 -I/usr/include  -I/home/matthias/rho-devel/rho/include -DNDEBUG -I. -I/usr/lib/jvm/java-7-openjdk-amd64/jre/../include -I/usr/local/include    -fpic  -g -O2 -fexceptions  -c Rglue.c -o Rglue.o
Rglue.c: In function ‘deserializeSEXP’:
Rglue.c:166:22: error: lvalue required as left operand of assignment
        EXTPTR_PTR(o) = (SEXP) go;
                      ^
make: *** [Rglue.o] Fehler 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘rJava’
* removing ‘/home/matthias/rho-devel/rho/library/rJava’

Die heruntergeladenen Quellpakete sind in
	‘/tmp/Rtmpx2KsZD/downloaded_packages’
Aktualisiere HTML Index der Pakete in '.Library'
Making 'packages.html' ... fertig
Warnmeldung:
In install.packages("rJava") :
  Installation des Pakets ‘rJava’ hatte Exit-Status ungleich 0

messages.subject: Re: install.package("rJava") fails
messages.body_plain:
Hi Matthias,

Currently rho doesn't work with a lot of the packages that define USE_RINTERNALS, and rJava is one of those (also Rcpp, data.table and xts are problems for us).  This is something that I'm hoping to sort out before long, but I haven't gotten to it yet.

Compiling the LLVM jit currently requires using clang as the compiler.  I apologize for the fact that it doesn't give a decent error message when using other compilers at the moment.

Karl

messages.body_plain:
Hi Karl,

thanks for your answer! I am looking forward to these developments.

This might be a rookie question then, but how would I compile it using clang, if I wanted to give it a try?

I installed llvm+clang by downloading and linking the binaries to the PATH, then Then I assumed that I could compile according to the instructions on github:

configure --enable-llvm-jit --enable-maintainer-mode
make
make check

I tried different versions of clang+llvm (3.5.0, 3.6.0 and 3.8.0) but always received errors during 'make'. E.g. (llvm 3.8.0):

[...]
/home/matthias/clang+llvm-3.8.0/include/llvm/ExecutionEngine/ExecutionEngine.h:534:3: note:   no known conversion for argument 1 from ‘llvm::Module*’ to ‘std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module>’
/home/matthias/clang+llvm-3.8.0/include/llvm/ExecutionEngine/ExecutionEngine.h:531:3: note: llvm::EngineBuilder::EngineBuilder()
   EngineBuilder();
   ^
/home/matthias/clang+llvm-3.8.0/include/llvm/ExecutionEngine/ExecutionEngine.h:531:3: note:   candidate expects 0 arguments, 1 provided
CompiledExpression.cpp:84:34: error: base operand of ‘->’ has non-pointer type ‘const llvm::DataLayout’
         m_engine->getDataLayout()->getStringRepresentation());
